title: A session fast-forwards its own clean checkout to main at start
why:

GitHub 02:34 CST contradicts it: PR #3141 is an OPEN DRAFT, head e9484864e5ec, mergeable clean, base main db3134aba78d (main has moved since), 5 files, 21 commits, not merged; its body still says review round 1 FAIL at 2b7a9f4a3 with fixes and round 2 pending. The step stays doing. The lane in the earlier note, session_013NEJL1gBhLAKfnu1hoQKiy, is the one the coordinator started at 00:56 CST; this step's lane field names the older session. Which read the coordinator meant is not yet asked.

PR #3141 is an open draft (triage REST 02:34 CST: head e9484864e5ec, not merged), with no replacing PR. This step stays doing.
